description:
Configure the starting parameters for the Northwind Traders business in Manager.io. 

1. Go to the 'Settings' tab.
2. Set the 'Start Date' to July 1, 2024 (2024-07-01).
3. Go to 'Starting Balances' (under Settings) and enter the following opening balances:
   - Cash on Hand: 25,000.00
   - Accounts receivable — Alfreds Futterkiste: 3,200.00
   - Accounts receivable — Ernst Handel: 5,300.00
   - Accounts payable — Exotic Liquids: 4,750.00

Save your changes. The Retained Earnings will be calculated automatically.
